En Rêve Design System
Source: local Design System repository, commit fa8c4b1, package version 0.1.0.
MIT license: see EN-REVE-LICENSE.

This checked-in bundle contains actual En Rêve button, icon, badge, dialog,
segmented-control/item, search-input, link, navigation, card, select/option,
checkbox, accordion-item and alert components and their shared token/styles/
interaction primitives. The source and bundling recipe are in scripts/vendor.mjs.
The static site requires no runtime CDN or package registry.

Bundled dependencies: Lit 3.3.3 and lit-html/lit-element/reactive-element (BSD-3-Clause),
signal-polyfill 0.2.2 (Apache-2.0), signal-utils 0.21.1 (Apache-2.0).
Full bundled dependency license texts are included alongside this notice.
